conditional_vs_unconditional: SecondForm is an internal helper predicate, proved by induction along every generated path; the admitted theorem is not a conditional SecondForm implication.
english_statement: For every finite Boolean Farey path, let its middle frame entry be (a,b,P) and d=a+b-1. The total-degree-(d-1) homogeneous component of P is exactly ((b-1)*U+(a-1)*V)*(U+V)^(d-2), as a polynomial over the integers.
exact_formal_claim:
∀ path : List Bool,
    let m := (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid
    let d := m.a+m.b-1
    MathGKM.Markov.totalComponent m.p (d-1) =
      (((m.b-1:ℕ):ℤ) • MathGKM.Markov.U + ((m.a-1:ℕ):ℤ) • MathGKM.Markov.V)*
      (MathGKM.Markov.U+MathGKM.Markov.V)^(d-2)

totalComponent_definition: Sum of c_P(i,j)*U^i*V^j over exactly the natural pairs i+j=n. The source proves its coefficient is coeff(P,i,j) on that degree and zero off it.
